prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated strong wins in rounds 3, 4, and 6.
Home wait_info changes can be helpful (4 winning tests in rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 6 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hint changes can be helpful (2 winning tests in rounds 4 and 6), though 8 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder and adoption new_flow changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Choose_path layout, finish copy, and home notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests each.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, and single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Tray Tutorial Screen: Adds a new tray guide screen right after the home intro stage showing how to control, hide, and interact with the pet from the desktop system tray. (why: 3 support emails reported user confusion regarding how to control or hide their pet after completing onboarding.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Visibility & Control Setup Flow: Adds an interactive tray control verification checklist component on the home intro screen to verify pet visibility before completing. (why: Support logged multiple tickets about pets failing to show on desktop or users losing track of them after setup.)
2: [home, redesign] Live Render Status Activity Log Stage Redesign: Redesigns the render waiting screen into a dynamic visual stage layout with animation components and step progress details. (why: The home rendering waiting screen takes median 201s (mean 2336s), creating a long drop-off window.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Data Recovery Hint: Adds a clear explanatory hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that signing in restores previous pet data. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation System Notification Toggle: Enables system notifications on the rendering waiting screen so users can minimize the app during long pet generation times. (why: Mean rendering wait time is over 38 minutes; enabling notify_when_ready prevents premature abandonment.)
5: [finish, copy] System Tray Pet Quick Controls Headline: Updates the home intro screen headline and body text to explicitly instruct users where the pet lives in the system tray. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to access, hide, or talk to the pet once onboarding finishes.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Account Auto-Save Reassurance Banner: Displays a hint on the path selection screen confirming that chosen paths auto-save to the user session. (why: The choose_path step sees a 20.4% drop-off; early auto-save assurance reduces friction.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Active Status Notification Prompt: Enables desktop ready notification settings on the final onboarding completion screen. (why: Support tickets reported users missing pet desktop launch or thinking the app failed to open.)

scores.note: New screens at finish step consistently reduce conversion (-2.6% historical average).
New flows perform poorly across steps; finish new_flow showed 0.0% impact.
Redesigns lack supporting evidence and frequently drop conversion.
Top support issue paired with sign-in hints having proven winning history (+1.4% avg).
Home wait_info changes have 4 winning tests and target long 38min mean wait times.
Finish copy changes showed consistently negative results (-1.8% over 2 tests).
Addresses 20.4% drop-off via low-cost hint copy, similar to positive copy tests.
Finish notification test previously showed strong negative impact (-5.0%).
